verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents table branching that forks isolated, writable lines of table history. Experiments, backfills and index rebuilds can run there without disturbing production reads on main, and there is a dedicated guide for isolating agent-driven experiments on branches and promoting only the winner. Versioning and snapshots add reproducibility. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that branching works as claimed, and evidence of a broader sandbox environment beyond per-table branches (e.g., separate test projects or credentials).
